messages.subject: Metric Invariance in ESEM
parts:
Dear Lavaan users,

The following lavaan codes for ESEM work well when I execute in JASP.

# efa block
efa("efa1")*f1 +
efa("efa1")*f2 +
efa("efa1")*f3 +
efa("efa1")*f4 =~ X1+X2+X3 +X4+X5+X6+X7+X8+X9+X10+X11+X12+X13+X14+X15+X16

My next goal is to test the metric invariance model, i.e, I want to test if the factor structure still holds when the factor loadings are constrained equal across three groups.

Any suggestion for the additional lines of the lavaan syntax above? That is, can you add a syntax so for texting the metric invariance model?

Thank you.

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Metric Invariance in ESEM
parts:
On 1/14/23 13:41, John Amora wrote:
> Dear Lavaan users,
>
> The following lavaan codes for ESEM work well when I execute in JASP.
>
> # efa block
> efa("efa1")*f1 +
> efa("efa1")*f2 +
> efa("efa1")*f3 +
> efa("efa1")*f4 =~ X1+X2+X3 +X4+X5+X6+X7+X8+X9+X10+X11+X12+X13+X14+X15+X16
>
> My next goal is to test the metric invariance model, i.e, I want to test
> if the factor structure still holds when the factor loadings are
> constrained equal across three groups.

Are you sure you want to do this in an exploratory fashion? Invariance
testing is usually done in a CFA framework.

> Any suggestion for the additional lines of the lavaan syntax above? That
> is, can you add a syntax so for texting the metric invariance model?

I am not how this works in JASP, but in regular R, you can just add the
group= argument, together with the group.equal = c("loadings") to force
the factor loadings to be the same across groups, and group.equal =
c("loadings", "intercepts") to also force the intercepts to be the same
across groups. Then via lavTestLRT(), you can compare those models.

Yves.
